title: Austin's Urban Plan & Economy Vision
summary:
*   City officials received an update on land use and development planning from the Zoning and Platting Commission.
*   A significant discussion took place regarding recommendations for a comprehensive economic development policy aimed at shaping the city's future growth.
*   This work session allowed city leaders to review critical information and strategies impacting urban planning and the city's economic future.
transcript:
CITY COUNCIL WORKSESSION 
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 9,2003
Austin City Council
MINUTES
WORKSESSION
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 9,2003
The following represents the actions taken by the Austin City Council in the order they
occurred during the meeting.
The City Council of Austin, Texas convened in a Work Session on Wednesday, April 9,2003
at One Texas Center, 505 Barton Springs Road, 3rd Floor Training Room, Austin, Texas.
Mayor Garcia called the meeting to order at 10:02 a.m.
PREVIEW OF ITEMS FOR NEXT WORKSESSION
BRIEFINGS
1. 
Report by the Zoning and Platting Commission on its goals and accomplishments.
The presentation was made by Betty Baker, Zoning and Platting Commission Chair
and Commissioners.
2. 
Report from the Mayor's Task Force on the Economy on the recommendations for a
comprehensive economic development policy.
The presentation was made by Council Members Wynn, and Dunkerley, John
Hockenyos, Texas Perspectives Inc., Sue Edwards, Director, Redevelopment
Services, Margo Weisz, Austin Community Development Corportion (CDC),
Randall Kempner, Prosperity Strategies Inc., and Mike Rollins, Chamber of
Commerce.
The motion to adjourn the meeting at 12:01 p.m. was approved on Council Member
Slusher's motion, Council Member Wynn's second on a 7-0 vote.
The minutes for the work session of April 9, 2003 were approved on April 24, 2003 on
Council Member Alvarez' motion, Council Member D linker ley's second on a 6-0 vote.
Mayor Garcia was absent.
